notes.title: Harvest mode and Easter event
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/5083360b3b680ce0196aa66cd4ac799b88bffad2.jpg[/img]

The Ultimatest Easter event just began, and will last until April 16th! 


[h1]■ Harvest mode [/h1]

This mode will be available for the duration of the event.
Collect eggs by digging the field, and bring back as many as you can to your base.
The team that brought the most eggs to its base at the end of the allotted time wins.
There are three different eggs: the blue and red worth 1 point, the yellows ones worth 3.
You can see the eggs of your team's color across the field.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/9bfc25c097bc1a1dca7d98e3c49ff20f752ebd7a.png[/img]
Each Nub can only take one egg by one, with the exception of the Glutton who can carry 3.
You can directly pick up the eggs at the opposing base.
When you carry an egg, you can not be under the effect of enchantment invisibility or invincibility. 


[h1] ■ Egg rankings and awards [/h1]

During the event you will win [b]Golden eggs[/b] as end-game reward, in any game mode.

These eggs can be exchanged for several rewards: from the simple weapon to the brand new [b]Easter grave in "Authentic" quality[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/8426364d88b8a739ad446ac1fb961f8ef7ab2a34.png[/img]

Get as many Golden Eggs as you can and be one of the Top 100 Harvesters of the Year to win [b]an exclusive numbered Golden Ladle[/b]!

Eggs exchanged for rewards will still count in your total eggs harvested.

Finally the three Easter pets (Tack O'Bell, Easter Tack O’Bell & Chocofowl) will be obtained as end-of-game reward for the duration of the event.



That's all about our Easter event!

Happy hunting to all, beware of liver attacks, and see you very soon for another Edionews.

notes.title: Leaderboards Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/0ad6696864d0396eac92e94bfe75c98134bf2f56.jpg[/img]

Hi everybody !

After a wait longer than expected, we announce you with great pleasure the return of the awaited leaderboards!


The different ladders are now visible from the UB Community tab.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/bdf89b0bb435b20bbd1fbcfec96a171144ffc280.png[/img]

You can find the rankings by XP, by CK, as well as the seasonal classification!


The first season started on [b]March 14th, and will end on April 30th.[/b] This test season will last exceptionally 1 month and a half instead of three, which will allow you to get your first seasonal rewards faster \o/

For more details on the different ladders,[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/669580/announcements/detail/1663386372407625669] go to the previous article[/url], or directly in game;)


Only the seasonal classification brings rewards at the end of each season, the other rankings are purely indicative, and allows you to compare your scores to those of other Nubs!


If you notice that your experience is not updated in real time, don't panic: the rankings are updated every 6 hours. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/bdedf6446501aebdccf867ebb49fe7c203625a7b.png[/img]

We let you discover all of this for yourself, and start to refuel XP to fight for the highest place in the seasonal leaderboard :D


Have a good game, and see you soon for another Ultimatest news!

notes.title: Celebrate the feast of love on UB
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/5ffb159716651927179ea17c6eeda31a5bf9763d.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone !

We are February 14th, world day of Love and Spiel: Take part in our Pick-up Line's event until the end of the month!


[h1][b]■ Pick-up line's Day[/b][/h1]

Log in before February 28 to receive [b]an exclusive pink hat[/b] for one of your Nubs!

During the event, you will get a [b]Giveaway Chest for every 300 Ubies spent[/b] on the store.

These giveaway chests must be used during a game, and will offer a random gift to another player on your server.

Using a giveway chest on a server with at least 8 players, you will receive the special title "[i]The Lover[/i]" highlighting your selflessness and generosity.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/ee58eeed85c188a07133e8275fc4c7c663bfc1b1.png[/img]

You can also try to win several gifts from the event by [b]transmutting Runes[/b]: in addition to the item it contains, you will also have a chance to get a Giveaway chest, a grave or a pet!


[h1][b]■ Ladders[/b][/h1]

[i] Celebrating Valentine's Day is cool, but we were waiting for the leaderboards! [/i]

Patience patience, the rankings will arrive just after the festivities of the Pick-up Line's Day, for a season that will exceptionally last 2 months instead of 3: from March to the end of April!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/bdedf6446501aebdccf867ebb49fe7c203625a7b.png[/img]
[i]More details in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/669580/announcements/detail/1663386372407625669]the previous article.[/url][/i]

The different rankings and seasonal rewards will be shown in game from the launch of the first season.

That's all dear Nubs, enjoy the event of Love on UB, and see you on March for the launch of the Ultimatest rankings !

notes.title: The Ultimatest leaderboards are on their way!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/c01740ae1d12fca7c83bd0a24df86e7e760ae83e.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,

We hope you had a good holiday, and that first month of 2018 was as happy as you expected!

Here is what awaits you for the next update: the long-awaited arrival of the [b]Leaderboards![/b]


As you may have guessed, ladders will allow you to know where you stand among UB's most experienced Nubs.
Different rankings and sub-rankings that you will be able to consult:

[h1]■ [b]XP Leaderboards:[/b][/h1]

-[b]Seasonal Ranking[/b]: With this ladder, you will allow you to be in direct competition with all the other current players. You will be able to see the 100 players with the most XP since the beginning of the season, as well as your place in the leaderboard.
Each season will last 3 months, at the end of a season rewards will be awarded according to your rank.

-[b]General Ranking[/b]: This ladder allows you to see the top 100 Nubs with the most amount of XP.


[h1]■ [b]CK Leaderboards:[/b][/h1]


-[b]General Ranking[/b]: Allows you to know the players who have accumulated the most victims on only one of their CK weapons.

-[b]Total CK Ranking[/b]: This ladder allows you to consult the list of the 50 players who have accumulated the most victims on all their CK weapons.

-[b]Weapon Ranking[/b]: You can also check the list of the 50 players who made the most kills with a particular weapon. Note that the alternative appearances of the weapons appear in this same classification.


[h1]■ [b]Guild Leaderboards:[/b][/h1]

-[b]XP Ranking[/b]: Highlight the 25 Guilds with the most experience points.

-[b]Quest Ranking[/b]: Allows you to know the 25 Guilds that completed the most common quests.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/bdedf6446501aebdccf867ebb49fe7c203625a7b.png[/img]
[i]SpeedArt made by Aranelle, just for this occasion[/i]

[i]A seasonal ranking with gifts! How to make sure you get the rewards? [/i]

Seasonal ladder will be systematically spread over [b]a period of 3 months[/b], during which the experience you accumulate will be counted.

When a season comes to an end, rewards will be awarded to the 100 Nubs with the most experience, as well as a consolation prize for players who got beyond the symbolic stage of 100,000 XP.

A new quality [b]"Season Reward"[/b] will appear at the end of the first season, which will allow you to spot items from a specific season.

All rewards will be communicated to you from the beginning of the season, we hope it will satisfy and motivate you to give the best of yourselves!



[h1]■ [b]FAN-ART CONTEST RESULTS[/b][/h1]

After waiting a month, here’s the top of our Christmas fan-art contest.

As usual, it was hard for us to decide between all your Ultimatest creations. The participants that didn’t make it to the top will still receive a tissue in « Reward » quality.


[b]In 3rd position:[/b]

[b][u]Haonia[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/45480f602f45e024e40c073f54aabbf78103675f.png[/img]
[i] A full sleigh, with all the nubs on board.[/i]

[b][u]Omontdieu[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/a228afb9dcf65f0e98e902dc939841f5dc376dfc.png[/img]
[i] An ice hammer for the viking, a skin suggestion that goes with the contest’s topic.[/i]

[b][u]Majonnie[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/c161f913c602ab3c4013ee0dab34dee3ea405483.png[/img]
[i] A comic full of joy and sharing to celebrate the holidays. :p[/i]

Congratulations to them, they win a bronze medal and a Christmas accessory in "reward" quality!


[b]In 2nd position:[/b]
[b][u]Ouroboros25[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/8cb76cd0ec7c1be330732cf10fb0b3f814310e90.png[/img]
[i]A Christmas ninja candle, homemade. A bright idea ![/i]


[b][u]Aranelle[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/673f662a038f4d40723b5333550186dfc3a0a6d6.png[/img]
[i] A beautiful, starry night sight, full of poesy.[/i]


[b][u]Nu4ge[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/570680f8db6adf35ff30050ecf4055f5e34abb5f.png[/img]
[i] As usual, nu4ge make us enjoy again her modelmaker’s talent.[/i]

Congratulations to them, they are awarded a silver medal, an accessory and a 2017 Christmas hat in "reward" quality!


[b]And finally, in 1st position:[/b]

[b][u]Vampiriou & Zombiriou[/u][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/99486d89c6a23643a088e986f7525ecce5432cc2.png[/img]
[i] A really nice christmas tree, with several christmas items replicas. [/i]

notes.title: 2017 Christmas Event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/073faddcdb98d56348d2d7d88a163e466a06653b.jpg[/img]
Happy Holidays !

The Christmas event just started on UB, enjoy the end of year festivities until December 29th included. 


[h1]■ [b][u]XMAS EVENT[/u][/b][/h1]

From December 15 to 29, collect a maximum of Ice Tokens to get exclusive items from Christmas 2017! 

[b] Remember to collect the daily rewards of your Advent Calendar, a gift per day awaits you until December 25th. [/b] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/354c818b1f4c8b253a626771e7d3dffc6d83aaf8.png[/img]

Get your Ice Tokens by accumulating "[u]Ice Fragments[/u]" throughout the event:
-In end-of-game reward.
-By finishing your daily quests.
-By participating in your Guild quests.
-By collecting it directly on the ground after killing an opponent. 

By combining 4 Ice Fragments you will get a brand new [u]Ice Token[/u], which you can use from the Main Menu for the rewards of your choice.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/f9b1299574587673e068317aa6d1d677f3cfc729.png[/img]

As tradition dictates, exclusive items to the Christmas event can also be obtained as end-of-game rewards at a low rate until December 25. 

[i]The different gifts you can redeem with Ice Tokens:
-[b]Christmas Accessory Chest[/b]: Costs 5 Ice Tokens, contains a 2017 Christmas accessory and a Lottery ticket.
-[b]Christmas Hat Chest[/b]: Costs 10 Ice Tokens, contains a 2017 Christmas hat and a Lottery ticket.
-[b]Title[/b]: Costs 20 Ice Tokens, grants you the new title "Cryo Genius" and a roll of Lottery tickets.
-[b]Tomb[/b]: Costs 20 Ice Tokens, grants you the new grave "Fireplace" as well as a roll of Lottery tickets.
-[b]2016 Christmas Chest[/b]: Costs 25 Ice Tokens, contains a lottery ticket as well as two Christmas hats 2016, or a chest of the previous year.
-[b]UBmon[/b]: Costs 40 Ice Tokens, grants you the new pet "Lilfoo" as well as a roll of Lottery tickets.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/c35ec9e588633dad345a795a6af91efded2c3301.png[/img]

The [b]2017 Christmas Rune [/b] will remain available on the shop until the end of the year, you can get one of the 7 exclusive weapons at Christmas 2017, or a Rune of the previous year.

With the [b]2016 Christmas Chest[/b] and the 2017 Christmas Rune, you'll be able to "[u]go back in time[/u]", and the luckiest of you may get exclusive items from a previous year.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/022e70779311d28fd423afd4c9b786b4fcc5b7ee.png[/img]

When you open a 2017 Rune, you have a slight chance of getting a rare bonus item: "[b]The Sleigh Bazooka[/b]"!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/0ccb0c567faf2f9090d61a38133b8951c4d839d2.png[/img]


[h1]■ [b][u]GUILD QUESTS MODIFICATIONS[/u][/b][/h1]

The Guild Quest System has been revisited so that all your allies can have their Guild Tokens, even if they were unable to participate in the quest.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/c4f665218abf82f344d13fbeacfd5db35e49f380.png[/img]

Now a member of your Guild connecting after the end of a quest will receive his Tokens at his connection, as long as new quests do not replace the previously completed quests.


[h1]■ [b][u]FANART CONTEST[/u][/b][/h1]

Remember that you have until the end of the year to send us your creations, either by posting them on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/669580/images/]Hub of the Steam community[/url], or by sending them directly by email to support@ediogames.com.

There is no imposed theme: drawing, sculpture, video etc, we accept everything your brain can imagine!

In any case remember to tell us your nickname in UB so we can easily give you your rewards, or consolation prices.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/637dda1806856129a2dee969c6eca80a4a34d354.jpg[/img]

That's about dear Nubs, we wish you all Ultimatest holiday season!

notes.title: Advent calendar and Christmas event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/68de7349449c223c6f4314fedeb5f6228c82e8c2.jpg[/img]
December is fast approaching, and you're probably wondering what's on UB for the end-of-year festivities.


[h1]■ [b][u]GUILD QUESTS[/u][/b][/h1]

The main new feature of the last Update is the introduction of [u]the Guild Quests![/u]

On the same principle as the daily quests, each Guild will receive 3 quests per day to recover XP, as well as "[b]Guild Tokens[/b]" for each Nub that participated in the Quests.

From your Guild's Menu, you can observe the three ongoing quests, their progress levels and the rewards related to them: 

-The XP earned by a quest is only assigned once to your Guild, regardless of the number of participants.
-The number of Tokens earned by a quest will be offered to all players who participated, so each player has his or her own Guild Tokens wallet.
-Unlike the Daily Quests, your 3 Guild Quests must be completed in order to have 3 new Quests the next day.
-There is now a "Rewindoguildoquest" item allowing you to receive 3 new Guild Quests. 
-It's always possible to exchange a quest per set, that is to say that once the change made, you must imperatively finish the 3 current quests before being able to change them again (unless you use a "Rewindoguildoquest").

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/504210b40523e8cf64c523a428adf2400e4b9dfa.png[/img]

In addition to the Quest page, a new "Rewards" tab has been added to the Guild Menu, so each member can pick up any of the available rewards, based on their number of "Guild Tokens", and the level of your Guild. 


/!\ Warning: Almost all of the items obtained as Guild Rewards are untradable. 
	        Guild Tokens are linked to your Guild, so be sure to spend your tokens before leaving a Guild, in which case your token count will drop to zero. 
	         Some items can only be obtained once your Guild has reached a specific level. 



[h1]■ [b][u]ADVENT CALENDAR[/u][/b][/h1]

As every year, you can collect one item per day by connecting to the game from 1st to 25th of December included. 

The calendar will be available from the Main Menu, just click on today's date to receive your daily gift. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/e23fc4a8b2effd85abeec34a5da26dd61bf61b9a.png[/img]

All calendar's rewards are untradable.

You will get different gifts, from classic items to Christmas skins, and the "Ice Tokens" as well: which will be used to choose from different prizes during the Christmas event to come. 


[h1]■ [b][u]CHRISTMAS EVENT[/u][/b][/h1]

From December 15th to 29th, you can enjoy the Overmine and Moon maps in the snow, as well as special rewards redeemable for Ice Tokens.

From the Main Menu, you will be able to get several exclusive prizes using your Ice Tokens: Christmas Rune, hats, accessories, etc.  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/a80fc38c111af62a4ca9575b4814cfa55a323e22.png[/img]

How to get Ice Tokens?
-In the advent calendar.
-In end-of-game rewards.
-By ending a daily quest.
-By participating in a Guild Quest.
-When picking them up during games.

notes.title: Halloween update (0.28.0)
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween Event[/h1]

Until November 13th, recover Vertebrae Rings by playing and completing your daily quests.
You can then exchange these Vertebrae Rings for Halloween items.

Zombie and Versus Boss game modes will be playable throughout the duration of the event.

Zombie Mode maps: Halloween Overmine, Halloween Plaine, Cimetiere
Versus Boss maps: Cimetiere, Fournaise

The Princess has put on her Halloween costume and is waiting for you on the Darkcaslte map.

New Halloween 2017 items:
[list]
[*]Boredingun (skin of Boardingun, for Soldier and Miner)
[*]Skeleton Shield (stock shield skin, for Viking)
[*]Shield of the Skeleton King (stock shield skin, for Viking)
[*]Monstrous Jaw (skin of Jaw, for Ranger)
[*]Cumulo 3000 (skin of Jetpack, for Miner)
[*]Bloody Blade (skin of Katanagony, for Ninja)
[*]Candy Bucket (skin of the Pasta, for Glutton)
[*]Dirework Rocket (fireworks skin, for all classes)
[*]Goat horns (accessory)
[*]DeVille Smile (accessory)
[*]Hypnotic pupils (accessory)
[*]Circular belt (accessory)
[*]Cursed Stump (tomb + ghost)
[*]Lil' Casimor (familiar)
[*]2017 Halloween Rune (contains a Halloween 2017 weapon or the 2016 Halloween Rune)
[*]Soldier Muerte (Soldier hat)
[*]Viking Muerte (Viking hat)
[*]Glutton Muerte (Glutton Hat)
[*]Ranger Muerte (Ranger Hat)
[*]Miner Muerte (Miner hat)
[*]Ninja Muerte (Ninja hat)
[/list]


[h1]Custom servers[/h1]

It is now possible to create your own server by choosing the maps, number of players and eventually a password.

Custom servers are hosted on our physical servers, as close as possible to your location.

It is possible to launch only one server per person.

A server is shut down only when it is empty for several seconds (you will not be able to launch another server as long as players are present on a server that you have previously launched).

Note that this feature is in beta and may be unavailable at any time.


[h1]New CK Weapons and Legendary Hats drop rate[/h1]

Chances of getting a CK weapon or a Legendary hat have been changed. Each time you open a Rune, if it does not contain a CK or Legendary, the chances that the next rune will contain are increased.


[h1]Weapon balances and changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bazookarton: now has 5 clips (instead of 6)
[*]Ram Shield: slows the target for 3 seconds (in addition to launching the target)
[*]Sugarcane Blowgun: gives 1 critical strike bonus to the target (in addition to the speed bonus)
[*]Machete: critical hit rate is now 1/50 (instead of 1/5), damage passes to 40 (instead of 45), inflicts bleeding for 4 seconds on each shot (instead of only on critical hit )
[*]Shovel-Mass: the right-click cooldown changes to 4 seconds (instead of 5)
[*]Kaptain Karnage's Shield: the weapon can now make critical hits
[*]Random Shield: reduces damage from -50%, 0%, 20% or heals 25% of the damages (instead of -50%, 0%, + 50%, + 100%)
[*]Wasabi Gas: the weapon can now make critical hits
[*]Healing escape: now removes the slowdowns and immobilizations (except traps and net) of the Ninja
[*]I Rule Bow, Bat, Shovel-Bat, The Log: right click's critical hit damages are correctly calculated
[*]Mamy Karnage's Bazooka: the number of clips decreased to 10 (instead of 20)
[*]Kunai of Teleportation, Maki of Teleporatation: right click's special action can be activated with the action key (E) without having this weapon active
[/list]


[h1]Social items[/h1]

You will find at the bottom right corner of the home page the list of social medias where you can find The Ultimatest Battle.
Follow UB on these social medias and get free items.
[list]
[*]Thumbs Up (skin of Leak, for all classes)
[*]Tweetbelt (accessory)
[*]Googlasses (accesssory)
[*]Thumbstone (tomb)
[*]Hashtomb (tomb)
[/list]


[h1]Bug fixes and other changes[/h1]

- It is now possible to correctly see the profile of a player during an exchange
> the nickname and avatar of the player are now clickable and open their profile in the community
> a cross on the top right corner closes the community window to return to the exchange

- The remaining time before a Rune is removed from the shop is now displayed
> Runes are changed every Wednesday at noon (GMT + 1)

- Added a "Details" link in the context menu of an item to display it in the Collection
> the collection will open in place of the current window, or over in the case of an exchange
> a cross on the top right corner closes the collection window in case it is opened over another window

- Rolls of Lottery Tickets can now be randomly obtained when opening a Quest chest

- Added a "Disassemble" link in the context menu of an item to quickly access the disassembly in the Workshop

- XP bar does not continue to fill after the lvl 100 (player XP and guild XP)

- News are now opened in the Steam overlay

- Added an explanatory popup of what is Premium during the first purchase of UBies
> a Premium account gains 120 additional inventory slots and can create its own Guild

- Fixed a bug that caused some sounds to be cut off early

- Fixed a bug that required to log off to receive a Lottery title

- Added an error message if the main menu remains grayed out too long after logging in

notes.title: Halloween’s coming!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/f90c03d6f0cbf34c840abcc1c1fd25a86548e2ff.jpg[/img]

Brace yourselves, Halloween is coming!

 
We wish you all a frightening October month and we’re going to tell you immediately what we will have in store for you for this Halloween event 2017. 


[h1]■ [b][u] Event Halloween[/u][/b][/h1]

Period : from [b]October 20th to November 12th[/b].

Theme of the year : [b]All Souls’ Day (Dia de los moertos).[/b]

Once again, this year, you can get your fill of exclusive new items playing during the Halloween period.

~Event sequence & rewards.

From October 20th to November 12th inclusive, you can get "[b]vertebrae ring[/b]" in different ways:

- As a reward for successfully played a game.
- Completing each of your daily quests (rewindoquests will grant you 3 additional quests).
- Killing your ennemies will sometimes award you an extra vertebrae ring.


From the main menu, you will have access to a special Halloween interface to exchange your vertebrae rings for chests containing a “[b]cursed item[/b]”:

- The Ominous chest (accessory) enables you to get one of the 4 new accessories, in “cursed” quality.
- The Ominous chest (hat) enables you to get one of the 6 exclusive hats of this year, in “cursed” quality.
- The Old Ominous chest enables you to get one of the previous Halloween accessories, in "cursed" quality too. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/307eeea64c8562cfbf765f8a169079b87ddf044f.png[/img]

Still in the interface where you can get your rewards, you will notice that 3 prizes out of 6 can be exchanged for “[b]Acid Cauldrons[/b]”.

[i]But what is an "Acid Cauldron" ? And what is the "Cursed" quality ?[/i]

An item with a "Cursed" quality can be used to get an "Acid Cauldron".

[b][u]WARNING : Once your “cursed” item is turned into an Acid Cauldron, it will be definitely lost.[/u][/b]

The “cursed” tiems will lose their quality after the event, however they won’t disappear from your inventory.

As a matter of fact, you can decide which item you want to keep and which one you can get rid of to get the rarest items of the event.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/bf4c1ea21d2e45ea22fbf5f5616bcaa30a8c3218.png[/img]


Here are the three tiems  you can exchange for your "Acid Cauldrons" :

-[b]The new title special Halloween[/b] (limited to 1).

-[b]A Nightmarish Chest[/b] (limited to 4), containing one of the following items :
.Une Rune Halloween 2017.
.The new familiar "Lil' Casimor", in authentic quality.
.A festive item "Darktifice rocket", in authentic quality.
.The new "Sylvester Grave", in authentic quality.

-[b]A Halloween chest 2016[/b] : enables you to get 2 Halloween hats from last year,
or a Halloween chest 2015 to go backward in time!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/6c3a1c4082cddd0914ecfc5ca3142fca82ff3e0e.png[/img]

You will always be able to exchange your vertebrae rings and your acid cauldrons until one week after the end of the event.
After this deadline, the "cursed" items will lose their quality and the Vertebrae Rings and acid cauldrons will disappear from your inventories.


[h1][b][u] The special modes[/u][/b][/h1]

During the event period, you will enjoy the Zombie and Versus Boss modes. 

-[b]The Zombie mode:[/b]
Play survivors and try to survive until the end of the time limit. 
A survivor killed while fighting will resurrect in the Zombie team and will have to overcome his former allies to win the fight.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/c8f76f13fa173652b89f2287de314b489f9bede7.png[/img]

-[b]The Versus Boss mode:[/b]
A player embodies the Boss and all the other players must get rid of him before the end of the time limit. 
The two available bosses are "Casimor, the giant Zombie" that you will fight on the graveyard map  ; and "Granny Karnage" that you will meet on the furnace map.

Please refer to the game tutorial for further information on these bosses.


[h1]■ [b][u] The Halloween Rune 2017.[/u][/b][/h1]

Available in one copy in the [b]Nightmarish chest[/b], the Halloween Rune 2017 will be also purchasable on the shop during the whole event.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/ed972045f997f1e0f2c77714dd581329dd5ca6df.png[/img]

In this event rune, you will be able to get one of the [b]exclusive Halloween 2017 weapons[/b]. You also have a small chance to receive a rare bonus item from this year: the [b]Shield of the Skeleton King[/b]!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/eab05e8addd5b27ede0a442c680a1fdfc841e344.png[/img]

During the opening of an event rune, you can get a rune from the previous year.
Then, you can [u]go back in time getting an always older rune[/u], in order to become the happy owner of an exclusive weapon from the previous Halloweens.

The weapons obtained in the event Runes don’t have the "Count Kheel" quality.


[h1]■ [b][u] Modification of the Runes transmutations.[/u][/b][/h1]

As you know it, every time a Rune is opened, you have a low chance to get a “[b]Legendary Hat[/b]”!

The way you can get legendaries has been improved: [u]every time a Rune is opened, your chance to get a Legendary increases slightly[/u].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/fa71569f9f1e6841ce620df78bd8dd76472e0ec5.png[/img]

Once a legendary hat has been transmuted, its obtention rate goes back to its initial value.

[b]That new system is retroactive![/b] It means that the more Runes you open without getting legendaries, the more chances you have to get one during your next transmutation. 


This new system also involves obtaining CK weapons: each time a Rune (containing CK) is transmuted and you get a hat or accessory, the probability of getting a CK at your next transmutation increases. 


[h1]■ [b][u]The opening of customized servers[/u][/b][/h1]

Many have been demanding this functionality, customized servers will show up from the next update ! 

From the list of servers, you can click on "[b]Create a server[/b]" in order to choose your maps, your modes and your server capacity.

After its approval, your server will be automatically hosted in the nearest area in order to optimize the latency period.

[i]If the latency remains high even in a server you’ve been creating yourself, do not hesitate to let us know indicating your location, we will take your reporting into account during the diversification of our servers locations.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/e295273657991387462133b35a95b888106121be.png[/img]

The same player won’t be able to open many servers simultaneously, you will have to wait for your server to be empty and to shut down before you open a new one.

New functionalities relating to the servers creations will be added in future updates. Do not hesitate to give us your feedbacks concerning this novelty :)


[h1]■ [b][u] FanArt Contest.[/u][/b][/h1]

Like every other year, a Halloween FanArt contest is organized to make you win exclusive event items in "Reward" quality. 

In order to take part in that contest, all you need to do is post your creation on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/669580/images/]community Hub[/url], indicating “Halloween 2017”and your nickname in the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/20ac6969be90df3190f4589a00b6ec04bb7a7325.png[/img]

You can also write at support@ediogames.com, without forgetting to indicate your nickname in the game The Ultimatest Battle.

The theme of this year is : Halloween, and [u]All Souls’ Day (Dia de los muertos)![/u]

There is no format requirements : drawing / video / sculpture, as long as your work links up with UB and the theme of this year.

We accept all participations [u]until November 2nd inclusive[/u], and every single participation will be at least rewarded with a consolation prize : so get out your pens !





That’s all for now dear Nubs.

Let us meet again for this ultimatest event from Friday, October 20th on UB!

Enjoy the game, and a happy frightening Halloween to all of you !

Many have been demanding this functionality, customized servers will show up from the next update ! 

From the list of servers, you can click on "[b]Create a server[/b]" in order to choose your maps, your modes and your server capacity.

After its approval, your server will be automatically hosted in the nearest area in order to optimize the latency period.

[i]If the latency remains high even in a server you’ve been creating yourself, do not hesitate to let us know indicating your location, we will take your reporting into account during the diversification of our servers locations.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/e295273657991387462133b35a95b888106121be.png[/img]

Like every other year, a Halloween FanArt contest is organized to make you win exclusive event items in "Reward" quality. 

In order to take part in that contest, all you need to do is post your creation on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/669580/images/]community Hub[/url], indicating “Halloween 2017”and your nickname in the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/20ac6969be90df3190f4589a00b6ec04bb7a7325.png[/img]

You can also write at support@ediogames.com, without forgetting to indicate your nickname in the game The Ultimatest Battle.

The theme of this year is : Halloween, and [u]All Souls’ Day (Dia de los muertos)![/u]

There is no format requirements : drawing / video / sculpture, as long as your work links up with UB and the theme of this year.

We accept all participations [u]until November 2nd inclusive[/u], and every single participation will be at least rewarded with a consolation prize : so get out your pens !





That’s all for now dear Nubs.

Let us meet again for this ultimatest event from Friday, October 20th on UB!

Enjoy the game, and a happy frightening Halloween to all of you !

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/1876197e52e4b124ae4355fcb05c7cee3b25de77.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

Two weeks after our arrival on Steam, we're back to tell you more about us and our prospects.

■ Recap of the release
■ By the way, what is Ediogames?
■ What is to come on UB


[h1]■ [b][u]Recap of the release:[/u][/b][/h1]

September, 12th 2017 will forever remain engraved in the UB’s history: a few minutes after our arrival on Steam, game servers were invaded by players from all over the world.

Very quickly there were more than 100 players connected simultaneously, and the servers have remained active since!

A lot assessed the game, so today our rating is between “rather positive” and “very positive”. Nothing could have made us happier, thank you everyone for this memorable reception!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/504210b40523e8cf64c523a428adf2400e4b9dfa.png[/img]

For the whole week after the release, we even were among Steam DB’s “popular New Release”, which is a kind of consecration for us, as we are just tiny independent developers.

As you know, the UB adventure on Steam is only beginning, so don’t hesitate to spread the word and to ask more plyers to give their feedback.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/95d003972914e24238cd285c6ffa1f37678e1d81.jpg[/img]


[b][u]After release modification:[/u][/b]

A release on Steam without any difficulty wouldn’t have been a true Steam release.

We thus had to quickly update the game so a maximum of players could play correctly.

We apologize to the Chinese players who had difficulties to get connected the first days. There shouldn’t be any problems now, yet don’t hesitate to tell us if you have any difficulty. 
At the moment our main priority is that everyone can play in the best conditions possible.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/0fae01934d225ce70b2c768e69c2d787a1dfc95d.png[/img]

The last updating has slightly increased the weight of the game in order to reduce the downloading time on the different Maps.

Problems related to disconnection while downloading the Maps have been solved almost entirely, yet it may happen on rare occasions.

If you have any problem that crashes your game, don’t hesitate to send us a report:
In the game Options, click on “Data”, then on “Bug Report”. Describe in a few words your problem, then click on “Send”.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/8527c34876f42bae14160c0d04fa77967db8c849.jpg[/img]

We work hard to get the game as smooth and pleasant as possible that is why we count on your feedback to keep improving with new updating.


[b][u]Hub Steam Community[/u][/b]

Most of you use this tool to give their feedback and share their UB experience; please, keep doing this :D

Reviews, forums, screenshots, artworks, etc…, we are excited about everything related to the UB universe: take a look at the inputs and please take a part in this.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/5755e238a1a567a1f68d63f751fc8f9851e1b25d.jpg[/img]
[i]Nebraska's Fanart[/i]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/669580/images/]The Hub Community Link[/url]


[h1]■ [b][u]By the way, what is Ediogames?[/u][/b][/h1]

We haven’t introduced ourselves properly, delighted to meet you :)

Ediogames is our creation studio composed of 7 members, among whom 3 work full time on the project. We have provided the UB prototype for free since summer 2013, when it was possible to play it.

And then we have kept on improving the game up to the version you know now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/6395b8fe1d7e2e3319f6e4ddc44b8ac24985dc05.png[/img]

Our idea is simple: offering a new way to play a platform game in a competitive way using skills players are already accustomed to.
A few years and more the 30,000 accounts later, we are on Steam with an English version enabling the whole world to fight for free in highly improbable epic battles.

As we are players ourselves, we make a point of offering a real Free-to-Play, and not a Pay-to-Win. All the gameplays are either given as a level reward, or quickly available through the loot, craft, etc.… Our shop consists essentially in cosmetic items, and no items can give more strength to some players and not to others.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/84b1a416efbf33ea249fbda94c83a5e2f1e80921.png[/img]

You are already more than 25,000 to discover UB since its Steam release, we can’t thank you individually but we mean it \o/

There are many things left to do and we are planning several contents and many improvements for the future!

Stay connected and please follow us on Steam, our website and the social networks.

-[url=https://twitter.com/playub]Twitter[/url]
-[url=https://facebook.com/UltimatestBattle]Facebook[/url]
-[url=https://www.ediogames.com]Our official Website[/url]
 

[h1]■ [b][u]What is to come on UB[/u][/b][/h1]

As we explained, we are working to settle disconnection and waiting time problems as efficiently as possible, but we are also planning some new contents for you to play with.

Our Halloween event will start on [b]October, 21st[/b] with different exclusive items for Halloween 2017.
The goal will be to collect as many “Vertebrae Rings” as possible to turn them into exclusive items for 3weeks!

We’ll give you more details in the next article with images so you can understand what you should expect next month. :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/bda81ccc8bf8a061b9ced251ae65a6f95c64f465.png[/img]
[i]You will discover our Zombie and Boss modes[/i]

We cab already tell you there will be a [b]FanArt competition[/b] with the theme: [b][u]Halloween, Celebrating the Dead![/u][/b]

The instructions are simple: your creation has to be related to UB as well as with the theme.
Besides that you are completely free!

There’s no format: drawings, comics, videos, songs, sculptures. We accept any work provided they are inventive and keep to the theme.
To be part you just need to post your creation on the Steam Hub, and give its title (Halloween 2017) + your username on UB.

You can also send your creations to support@ediogames.com And don’t forget to give your nickname.

You can post your work until [b]November, 2nd included[/b] and we will give you the results at the end of our Halloween event.

The winners will get exclusive items linked to the event, as a “reward”. Each participant will be given an item, so don’t hesitate to submit your creations!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30441290/0115700dd81af0cdddbcfe78e0137e9965330e68.jpg[/img]
[i]One of the last year's winner : Steyix[/i]


That’s all folks, we get back to you with another Ultimatest news!
